name: sustainable_materials_dataset
description: This dataset provides detailed information on a wide range of materials with sustainable properties, focusing on their environmental impact, recyclability, biodegradability, and potential applications. It includes both natural and engineered materials used across industries such as construction, packaging, automotive, and product design. The goal is to support research and development in eco-friendly alternatives by offering structured data for machine learning models, sustainability assessments, and material selection processes.
creator: Jayasimma D
